text: Besides claude_version (ste2), a [history] exempt change also makes every queued reading stale: after #132 added one exemption, 4kgd was read again a second time within an hour and, because readers word scope differently each time, waited for acceptance again. Settings that cannot change what a job should do (history exemptions, the harness version) should not invalidate readings, and a re-read that changes only wording should not need accepting.
